purpose: Check the CP1251/byte-codepoint candidate in VR: does arial draw Cyrillic for the VR option captions?
protocol: Original 0.9.1 DLL replaced by the candidate, one game launch, VR started, Options -> VR page opened with controllers.
what_was_pressed: launch via version launcher (PID 28216, launcher PID 11776)
VR session started on Quest 3 through Virtual Desktop
looked at the option rows and the bottom hint

what_was_seen.captions_vr_page: empty: no glyphs at all where TURN MODE / SNAP TURN ANGLE / ... should be
what_was_seen.game_values: rendered correctly in Russian: ВЫКЛ, ВКЛ, 120 /, НАЗАД
what_was_seen.crash: none; Game exited normally with code 0 after ~74 s

key_lines: [preview] only the main menu and the main campaign can load; the DLC levels are refused
[menus] 'mevr_reload_pouch' refused: lists need 2-255 printable ASCII labels
[menus] 126 settings registered before the game loads its preferences
[menus] 29 menus loaded (3 replaced, 26 new), 221 captions set

conclusion: CP1251 at code-point indices is wrong: arial has glyphs only for 0x20..0x7E, so every Cyrillic byte resolves to an empty tcmap record (blank caption) or to a two-byte escape (tofu). Confirms A-0029: glyph = font_table[byte], where byte is a charmap index and the table belongs to the font.
